criteria.intent: Prepare a small transparent original vector of the exact requested expression in ribbon-family colors.
criteria.automated_scope: Actual SVG byte/gzip/element/command bounds, inert vocabulary, finite unclipped control geometry, expression metadata and continuous gradient; meaningful unsafe/incorrect mutations fail. Glyph recognizability and final-scene composition require visual review.

criteria.intent: Integrate one large central Writing-only formula with coherent camera/depth/media/offline behavior and readable foreground content.
criteria.automated_scope: One Writing-only world landmark in both detail tiers, finite perspective corners, mild authored tilt and closed ambient pulse/depth motion, normal scene depth sorting and no DOM banner. Canonical artwork is projected in the existing static scene; immutable runtime/media identity derives from that artwork. Visual composition remains an explicit review decision. The staging package consumer also rechecks the exact four-media declaration and immutable copies while preserving the legacy three-media contract.

criteria.intent: Preserve bounded single-clock lifecycle, cache/initialization, navigation and graceful fallback.
criteria.automated_scope: Fixed 1380×240 single raster cache, bounded perspective/extrusion draw submissions, one logical landmark per paint, existing clock and frozen Off/reduced scene ownership, failure containment. Focused Linux Chromium/Firefox report fixtures preserve writing-only/fallback/zero-work observations; actual current-source measurements remain separate evidence. The staging package consumer also rechecks the exact four-media declaration and immutable copies while preserving the legacy three-media contract.

criteria.intent: Measure the exact implementation against paired baseline and unchanged absolute performance budgets in this PR.
criteria.automated_scope: Maintained paired report validator recomputes raw measurements, enforces fixed Color source/artifact identities, three ordered pairs per profile, absolute budgets and declared before-measurement added-cost limits. Meaningful missing/misbound/incomplete/over-budget/concealed-quality/resource-growth negatives fail. Validator fixtures are not a measured performance result; exact-head opt-in run remains separately reviewed.

criteria.intent: Preserve owning-issue/Draft-PR handoff, RI routes and honest pending implementation, then reconcile the original acceptance before closure.
criteria.automated_scope: Current catalog/views and real CI coupling, owning-issue selection, pending-gate semantics and deliberate opt-in event/source/retention controls. Basic remains owned by existing site-checks; no duplicated full release suite. Joint staging runs the eleven #41 catalog/source checks in this same selected policy, once per unique check. Companion acceptance retains its separate AC IDs, gates and issue mapping.

G01.description: Visual review of actual Writing composition, exact glyph meaning, foreground readability and Day/Night/mobile behavior; a standalone asset preview does not complete scene acceptance.

G02.description: Current-source Linux Chromium/Firefox observations: one logical world formula with positive paints, Off/reduced/hidden/print settled zero work, room isolation, coherent static/no-JS/no-Canvas fallback, bounded cache failure and offline export. WebKit stays in native macOS production coverage. Fixture success alone is not measured runtime evidence.

G03.description: Exact-head opted-in paired Color measurements and raw artifacts must pass the unchanged absolute limits and predeclared median added-cost guardrails. Reviewer verifies source/tree/public digest and three serial profiles; absent, failed or inconclusive measurement stays open.

G04.description: Live issue/PR/Refs commits/exact handoff and CI links, independent implementation review. Applicable physical-device and full native production evidence stay with #13 before production, and do not block delivery of a smoke-checked PR preview or beginning bounded staging validation.

G05.description: Only after applicable maintainer decision: normal merge of accepted implementation and exact merged-source reconciliation. Implementation/CI/preview do not supply merge authorization.

I41-EDITORIAL.description: Source/editorial review of exact roles and contribution verbs, admitted editions and per-platform dates, neutral Reddit disposition, public and structured-data claim boundaries, before/after semantics and actual readable layout. Preserve separate existing rights/device/release owners; do not invent source access or advisor correspondence inspection. Reddit numbers require the dated snapshot note; community criticism and the supplied historical claims are not validation.

I41-REVIEW-MERGE.description: Record independent review honestly, exact current-source Basic/targeted/navigation/acceptance and preview artifacts, live PR/Refs commits at the issue anchor, actual AC checkbox reconciliation and maintainer merge decision. Compare merged source with accepted candidate before closure; implementation is not release approval.

I41-BROWSER.description: Inspect matching current-source PR Chromium smoke and targeted Home/Research/Writing Day/Night desktop/narrow layout, advisory anchors, filters/history/print, Off/reduced motion and bottom reach. Record report/public digest/source binding; this policy cannot ingest hosted reports. Separate first-release physical-device requirements remain with their owners.
